top_signals.title: Firmus Seeks to Raise $5 Billion in Landmark Australian IPO
top_signals.summary: Data center operator Firmus Grid Ltd. is looking to raise at least $5 billion in an initial public offering, according to terms of the deal seen by Bloomberg, kicking off one of the biggest-ever listings in Australia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
